decisions.decision: B owns Context assembly, versions, execution, event writing, resume, and interaction storage. A only persists collab_context_id on the Todo and projects the B event stream.

A does not create ac_todo_interaction. A calls B POST /api/v1/collaboration/task/context_collab/{collab_context_id}/events to define/append human interaction events and filters the B event stream for the public interaction history.
A polls B through its own GET /openapi/v1/todos/{todo_id}/events while a Todo is in_progress, projects finish events to pending_acceptance, and displays artifact name/address from B events.
Rejected acceptance only appends the B human_acceptance event and atomically moves A state to in_progress; B owns resume. The frontend does not call Run again after rejection.
Gateway routes /openapi/v1/todos/** verbatim to backend with a required human user. Backend calls B only through TodoCollaborationPlugin; the browser never calls B directly.
Personal-space Bot eligibility fails closed by requiring current actor, personal Space owner, and Bot owner agreement.

escalations.context: The remaining blockers require A/B ownership, routing, idempotency/recovery, and snapshot-validation decisions. Choosing these contracts automatically could change data integrity, failure semantics, deployment routing, and user-visible behavior.
attempts_summary: A-side CRUD, interaction persistence, acceptance flow, and frontend surfaces were implemented and validated.
Repository review found no existing B callback/subscription, Todo events/run route, or Gateway mapping that resolves the contract gaps.
already_tried: Inspected A Todo models, repository protocols, services, and frontend B calls.
Searched BCS routes/contracts and Gateway configuration for Todo events/run integration.
Inspected rejection rerun ordering and interaction boundary construction.
current_blockers: R2: no B-to-A latest execution/snapshot projection write contract.
R3: rejected acceptance can become unrecoverable when /run fails.
R4: B events/run endpoints have no proven deployed route.
R5: interaction snapshot/execution/event boundary is trusted from the browser.
missing_evidence: Approved A/B API and routing contract.
Approved ownership and enforcement point for snapshot boundary validation.
decision_needed: Choose how B updates A latest execution/snapshot/status projection and when.
Choose the deployed route for B Todo events/run calls and freeze auth/envelope/error contracts.
Choose /run idempotency and recovery semantics for rejected acceptance reruns.
Choose whether A or B validates interaction snapshot_id, execution_id, and last_event_seq ownership/boundary.
escalations.resolution: User confirmed the B context/event API contract and A ownership boundary; A has no interaction table, B owns storage/resume/events, and Gateway serves the public A surface.

findings.title: 个人空间 Bot owner 校验缺失
findings.finding: Todo 的后端和前端 Bot 范围校验在 bot.space_id 与当前个人空间相同时直接通过，未同时校验 bot.owner_id、当前 actor 和 personal_owner_id 一致；异常或历史数据可使其他用户的 Bot 被选中。
evidence: Current tests cover matching/mismatching spaceId and owner fallback only, not same personal spaceId with a foreign owner.
findings.required_action: 在个人空间边界 fail closed：同时校验 Bot owner、actor 和 personal space owner，并补充后端及前端回归测试。
findings.resolution: Regression tests and Gateway/public contract verification completed.

findings.title: B 到 A 的最新执行投影没有写入契约
findings.finding: TodoModel 虽包含 latest_execution_id/status、latest_snapshot_id、latest_event_seq 及执行时间，但 A 的 repository protocol、repository 和 service 均无写入入口，也未发现 B callback、消息订阅或共享库契约。前端互动依赖该投影，缺失时无法互动。
findings.required_action: A/B 明确由谁、通过什么接口、在什么时点更新 Todo 的最新 execution/snapshot/status 投影。
findings.resolution: A polls the B event stream and projects finish events to pending_acceptance; contextual execution data remains in B.

findings.title: 拒绝验收后 Run 失败会留下不可恢复状态
findings.finding: 前端先调用 A 将 rejected Todo 原子改为 in_progress，再调用 B /run；若 /run 失败，A 不回滚，而当前 UI 对 in_progress 不提供重试、互动或再次验收入口，Todo 可能永久卡住。
findings.required_action: 确认 /run 幂等和失败恢复契约：允许 in_progress 重试、调整调用顺序，或提供可靠异步补偿。
findings.resolution: Rejection now appends a B human_acceptance event and atomically moves A state to in_progress; B owns resume and no second Run is issued.

findings.title: B 的 Events 和 Run 路由在真实部署链路中不存在
findings.finding: 前端通过同源相对地址请求 GET /openapi/v1/todos/{id}/events 和 POST /openapi/v1/todos/{id}/run；A 未实现这两个接口，BCS 未发现对应路由，Gateway 也没有 todos 域的分流或 rewrite，部署链路无法证明可达。
evidence: No matching Todo events/run route found under apps/bcs or apps/backend.
findings.required_action: 确认由 Gateway 按 leaf path 分流、使用独立 B API client/base URL，或采用其他正式路由；同时冻结认证、Envelope、错误和幂等契约。
findings.resolution: Gateway now publishes /openapi/v1/todos routes and forwards them verbatim to backend; B is called server-side through TodoCollaborationPlugin.

findings.title: 互动的快照与事件边界完全信任客户端
findings.finding: A 创建互动时只校验字段非空、长度及 last_event_seq >= 0，未验证 snapshot_id/execution_id 属于当前 Todo，也未验证 last_event_seq 是该执行的真实边界。前端事件加载失败时会以空列表计算并提交 0。
findings.required_action: 明确快照边界验证责任在 A 还是 B；若 A 无法读取 B 快照，需定义服务间校验或让 B 在消费互动前强校验。
findings.resolution: A no longer persists interaction input; it appends a B event using the B event boundary and retrieves interaction history from the B event stream.
